headline: Ethos Limited Takeover Disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31
sum: Ethos Limited disclosed a substantial acquisition triggering SEBI takeover regulations, filing mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Ethos Limited, the publicly listed jewellery and watches retailer, submitted a mandatory disclosure to NSE under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers (SAST) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) and (5) typically govern disclosure by acquirers who cross the 25% threshold or conduct an open offer. The filing date of 28 April 2026 on NSE archives suggests the acquisition event occurred shortly before or was announced in that window. The specific acquirer identity, consideration amount, and deal structure remain to be confirmed from the full disclosure document.
